meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Python应用需要部署到Azure App Service
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 把 Python 代码（Flask/Django/FastAPI 等）部署到 Azure App Service Linux；资源组、计划或 Web 应用不存在时会自动创建；部署完成后打印一条后置消息并结束，不做健康检查。
howto.when: 当你说出“Flask App Service”、“Django App Service”等关键词，或要求把 Python 部署到 Azure App Service 时触发。

say.text: 把 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service
say.note: 它会自动创建资源并部署代码

say.text: 帮我部署 Django 到 App Service，用默认设置
say.note: 框架自动检测，无需手动配置

say.text: 部署 FastAPI 应用，启动命令用 uvicorn
say.note: 它会设置启动命令并部署

howto.what_en: Deploys Python code (Flask/Django/FastAPI etc.) to Azure App Service Linux; auto-creates resource group, plan, and web app if missing; prints a post-deploy message and ends, without health checks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", or ask to deploy Python to Azure App Service.

say_en.text: Deploy my Flask app to Azure App Service
say_en.note: It will create resources and deploy code automatically

say_en.text: Deploy Django to App Service with defaults
say_en.note: Framework is auto-detected, no manual setup
It sets the startup command and deploys
